row.body: A laundry token is tied to the restaurant key, but the posted pickup list ends before the names marked “still here.”
row.title: The last clean towel

sidecar.gloss: A local pickup list stops before it accounts for everyone waiting.
sidecar.rival_reading: A private laundry arrangement could explain the token and list; the unfinished names do not establish an official evacuation.

row.body: red and blue cord join the black pen to the bath towel. the red route is cut; the blue route ends in a sealed knot.
row.title: missing count beside the black pen

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
